name: Ghoul Fang
summary: In Duskwood, Ghoul Fang is gathered from the undead for Madame Eva’s protective talismans. The fangs are essential to her work in Darkshire, where travelers face the forest’s encroaching darkness.

sections.title: Trophies of the Restless Dead
sections.body: Ravenous undead haunt Duskwood’s shadowed woods and graves. Flesh Eaters lurk near the burial grounds, while Rotted Ones roam among the trees. Taking a fang from these creatures is grim work, and proof of survival against the dead threatening Darkshire’s borders.

sections.title: Occult Reagents
sections.body: Madame Eva, Darkshire’s fortune teller and mystic, sees terrible omens around travelers who cross Duskwood. She combines ghoul fangs with skeletal fingers and arachnid venom to enchant the Totem of Infliction. The charm turns the forest’s dark forces against violent assault, protecting the one who bears it.

faq.q: Where can Ghoul Fangs be found?
faq.answer: Various types of ghouls haunt Duskwood’s graveyards and lonely pathways. They include Plague Spreaders, Brain Eaters, Bone Chewers, Fetid Corpses, Rotted Ones, and Flesh Eaters.
Madame Eva, the mystic in Darkshire, needs Ghoul Fangs for the ritual that crafts the defensive Totem of Infliction.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva need them?
aliases: what does madame eva do with fangs
faq.answer: Madame Eva senses danger gathering around travelers. She uses the fangs with skeleton fingers and spider venom to enchant a protective totem that punishes anyone who strikes its bearer.

angles.text: For Alliance adventurers helping embattled Darkshire, gathering these fangs turns Duskwood’s horrors into tools for survival against the encroaching Scourge-like taint.
